Then the system stores none of the three documents and no decision log entry is written

  Scenario: AC15 A caller without Documents C is refused with 403 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an officer in scope of case "RW-2026-000301" who lacks Documents C
    When the officer requests generation for treatment "TRT-0301" and template "DIL-CONTRACT"
    Then the response is 403 with MSG-P4-002
    Then the system stores nothing

  Scenario: AC16 A national ID number is filled at render time and never logged (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the party of case "RW-2026-000301" has a national ID number
    When the engine runs for treatment "TRT-0301" and template "DIL-CONTRACT"
    Then the token service is called at render time for that national ID number
    Then the clear value appears only inside the stored PDF and in no log entry

  Scenario: AC17 The provided operations answer 401 without a valid token and 403 without Documents C (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a request to the generate operation with no valid token
    When the request is sent
    Then the response is 401 and the system stores nothing
    Given a request to the generate operation with a valid token and no Documents C
    When the request is sent
    Then the response is 403 with MSG-P4-002

  Scenario: AC18 A downstream contract that does not answer within 2 s is refused with 503 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-comms template catalog contract does not answer within 2 s
    When the engine runs for treatment "TRT-0301" and template "DIL-CONTRACT"
    Then the response is 503 with MSG-GEN-006 naming "rwb-comms"
    Then the system stores nothing and the drafting area is cleaned as in X5
    Then the retry count is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P5-E2026-APP-AC18)
